summary: The design is directionally viable, but several contracts conflict with the current SDD configuration, metadata parser, release workflow, and documentation links. The highest risks are publishing unreleased main commits, silently incomplete API output, and a warning-only gate accidentally inheriting blocking closeout behavior.

suggestions.title: Model techwiki in the typed SDD configuration
suggestions.rationale: `SddConfig` uses `extra="forbid"`, while the current `sdd/config.json` has no techwiki section. Adding the proposed object without extending the Pydantic model will make every SDD config load fail; add a nested validated model with backward-compatible defaults.

suggestions.title: Do not route docs metadata through FlowMeta
suggestions.rationale: `sdd_meta.parse()` returns `FlowMeta`, whose contract only covers `type` and `base_branch`; it does not expose `docs`. `techwiki check` therefore needs a dedicated typed documentation-metadata parser or an explicit shared frontmatter model, including malformed and absent-key behavior.

suggestions.title: Publish from the release boundary, not every main push
suggestions.rationale: The Pages workflow runs on every push to `main`, while PyPI publication is driven by the separate release workflow. `git describe --tags` on an ordinary main commit can select an older release tag while the generator reads newer, unreleased code. Make wiki publication downstream of a successful release or require an exact release tag/PyPI version.

suggestions.title: Make source triggers cover the whole workspace
suggestions.rationale: The existing documentation workflow watches only `packages/ai-parrot/src/parrot/**`, but the workspace contains many satellite distributions and the release matrix publishes them separately. The techwiki workflow must trigger on every configured package source, package metadata, lock/config inputs, and its own workflow or satellite API changes will not regenerate the wiki.

suggestions.title: Specify non-blocking closeout handling explicitly
suggestions.rationale: The existing E2E gate treats nonzero exit status as an immediate closeout abort, and both `/sdd-done` twins rely on that behavior. A `techwiki check` status of 2 for malformed metadata must be captured and reported as a warning without accidentally blocking closeout or hiding genuine invocation failures.

suggestions.title: Make the documentation contract stronger than path existence
suggestions.rationale: The current spec template still says documentation is updated in `docs/`, and the proposed check only verifies declared page paths. A zero-byte or placeholder wiki page could pass. Define the exact `docs:` YAML schema, validate title/H1/non-empty content and declared API-module syntax, and update the generic acceptance/template language for wiki documentation.

suggestions.title: Make the techwiki extra self-contained
suggestions.rationale: `griffe` is not currently declared, and `jinja2` appears only in a broad optional dependency group rather than as a dedicated renderer dependency. The new extra must declare direct, versioned dependencies and Python markers itself; also resolve the design's stated Python 3.10 floor against the repository's current `>=3.11,<3.14` package floor.

suggestions.title: Freeze the generated API surface with golden fixtures
suggestions.rationale: Current mkdocstrings configuration filters underscore names and merges `__init__` into classes, while the proposed renderer adds namespace packages and all distributions. The specification needs explicit rules for `__all__`, re-exports, overloads, properties, Pydantic/dataclass fields, and package-to-source mapping, backed by deterministic fixtures and golden output. Parse failures should fail or be listed prominently, not silently reduce coverage.

suggestions.title: Use stable page identifiers instead of title-derived links
suggestions.rationale: Flattening authored and generated pages from mutable titles creates instability around renames, punctuation, Unicode and collisions. Keep a canonical logical page ID in the bundle index and derive every link from that manifest; test the actual GitHub-wiki filename behavior rather than relying on one observed hyphen substitution.

suggestions.title: Plan migration compatibility and link verification
suggestions.rationale: Existing chapters and the site index contain many links into `docs/api-reference/**`; removing those files breaks internal navigation and existing Pages URLs. An index note is not a redirect. Rewrite and verify all internal links before deletion, and either generate redirect stubs or explicitly accept the URL breakage as a versioned change.

suggestions.title: Run bundle validation before merge
suggestions.rationale: The proposed main-only sync discovers dangling links and renderer failures only after merge, leaving the previously published wiki stale. Run a read-only bundle in PR CI or as a mandatory pre-PR hook, upload its report, and keep the SDD documentation presence check as the separate warning-only discipline gate.

suggestions.title: Add foreign-repository and asset-sync coverage
suggestions.rationale: The asset synchronizer covers command/template twins and rejects shipped monorepo-specific paths, while the release workflow already exercises the SDD wheel in a foreign repository. The new techwiki commands must use only configured repo-relative paths, regenerate `_assets/`, pass asset sync, and prove `check` works without the optional griffe extra in a foreign repo.
